dependency_closure.method: recursive literal project-include superset including all conditional arms; excludes unbuilt catalog targets; toolchain/system headers qualified by each native receipt

findings: Both AVX512 point timed loops are byte-identical including all indirect-call setup/repeated source and function-pointer stack loads, query load, accumulator and loop branches. Actual selected dense_point callees are byte-identical too, with no dependent descriptor load, extra branch or spill. Their addresses change; caller inner loops and both callees move by32 modulo64. This bounds added-instruction explanations but does not dismiss observed bimodality or prove a predictor/layout cause.

For actual AVX2 all-row substituted mutation drivers, compiler devirtualizes the bound operation directly to the selected region: 41 instructions between benchmark timer calls in each arm, same opcode schedule. Pointer/stack slots differ; no additional dispatch/selection work is introduced in this outer loop.

Each full256-row substituted tile executes16 body and16 head0 coverage helpers (k63 also16 head1), each covering two physical8-row original tiles separated by stride64. Real body/head spans are disjoint and append twice. The same-source target-tail helper is skipped at all16 sites in both original before and finalR4; R3 alone had unconditional no-op calls.

Regular actual body path grows56→63 instructions and head paths59→66, adding one callee-saved push/pop pair, one unconditional branch and register bookkeeping, with eight conditional branches unchanged. First body after substituted tail also adds7. This yields7168 additional traced helper instructions per8192-row k31 operation and10752 for k63; these are source-derived instruction counts, not PMU events or a cycle estimate. Main region shrinks and may offset other work.

The helper overhead is a concrete remaining lead for AVX2 losses, not an attribution of the complete5–7% elapsed loss. Isolated flat-journal lowering ablation is being prepared separately; no production alignment or blanket inlining is selected.
